positive.prompt: Walk me through PR #482 one logical section at a time and wait for me before continuing
Give me a step-by-step tour of commit 4f9c2ab and wait after each logical section
Walk me through my unstaged worktree changes in dependency order without editing or staging them

negative.prompt: Verify the base and head branches, check for duplicates, and open a draft GitHub pull request with a convention-aware title and validation evidence
Reconstruct and persist the current system's module architecture and runtime collaborations beyond this PR
Refactor duplicated code in the changed module while preserving its verified behavior

evals.prompt: Walk me through my staged and unstaged changes. Keep those sources distinct. I know the frontend but not the persistence layer. Focus on request flow, state changes, and tests. Start the first section and wait for me.
evals.expected_output: A snapshot-fixed tour map followed by only the first logical change section and an explicit checkpoint.
expectations: Staged and unstaged sources remain distinct in the captured snapshot
The change is grouped into a small dependency-ordered tour rather than listed file by file
The response explains only the first section with concise code locators and evidence labels
The response waits at a checkpoint and offers controls for continuing or going deeper
prohibitions: Do not explain later sections before the user advances
Do not modify the repository, index, or remote state
Do not present comprehension as approval, commit authority, or a code-review verdict
